column4: Scaffold complete: three r187 vendored (build + examples/jsm), index.html with import map, src/main.js (ACES tone mapping, PCF shadows — PCFSoft was removed in r187 — orbit camera with 5 presets, seeded RNG, URL params, FPS HUD, window.__diag every frame), placeholder ground disk + box, tools/views.json with 7 review views. Verified with `node tools/shot.mjs --all`: exit 0, zero errors/warnings, fps ~60.6, __diag.ready true in all views. Note: this model cannot read PNGs; review was stats-only as permitted.

Built the full T02 sky/lighting system (Sky addon, throttled PMREM env, sun/moon/stars/fog/haze dome, day-cycle advance) and fixed three root-cause bugs found via framebuffer pixel probing: NaN-poisoned env from the addon's clouds, pre-first-frame PMREM corruption, and sun-disc radiance flooding the env. All 7 views render at 60fps with 0 errors; day/sunset/night now differ correctly but day is slightly hot (brightPct 12-31%), sunset too dark, night too black — exact tuning plan written in .ai/handoff.md, task left [~].

Tuned the sky/lighting balance to spec (sunset ~18:40 for a golden glow at 18.5, readable moonlit night, non-blown day) and verified T02 done-criteria: shot.mjs --all exits 0 with zero errors and fps ≥ 60.4 in all 7 views, dbg pixel-scan shows crisp acne-free PCF shadows, and the day cycle advances when unpaused.

Built the floating island (src/island.js): noise heightfield terrain with deterministic soft rim, rock-lip-sealed craggy underside with strata texture, soil ceiling, 14 hanging roots, and cloud/haze layers below — all procedural canvas textures with normal maps. Verified: 0 console errors and fps 60.3+ in all 7 views, 24 draw calls, and 0 holes/seams via a 2376-ray CDP raycast test after the rim-seal fix.

Built src/pagoda.js: parametric five-tier pagoda at (0,−14) with stone plinth + steps, plaster walls, vermilion posts, simplified tokyō, concave upturned tile roofs (4-patch grids + ridge/corner ridges + eave fascia), sōrin spire — merged per material into 6 draw calls (~29k tris). Verified via shot.mjs --all (0 errors, fps 60.3–60.6, pagoda view edge 5.8→13.9, col4 94→268, low quality 48k tris) and dbg.mjs pixel probes (working readPixels recipe: render synchronously first — tier layering, vermilion, dark tile bands, plaster + shadow bands all confirmed). Shape and Materials score 4/4.

Built src/pond.js: irregular basin carved into terrain at (0,12) (exported basinHeight/waterR for koi), Water-addon reflective surface (rf0 0.22 shader patch, procedural ripple normals, distortionScale 2.4), 26 merged edge stones, lily pads; reframed pond preset to (4.5,4.6,19.5) and fixed shoreline overlap (+0.85u). Verified via render-diff that pagoda+sky reflect in the water; --all shows 0 errors, fps 60.4–60.6, no view regressions. Remaining: judge reflection clarity in stills (maybe raise rf0), check night/low-quality pond, then tick [x].

Fixed the water's missing reflection: the Water addon derives its mirror plane from the mesh transform, but the fan had y=2.55 baked into vertices with an identity mesh (mirror was a vertical plane, previous "verified" diff was a false positive on stone pixels). Rebuilt the fan in the local XY plane with position+rotation on the mesh; sky (water centre 177,212,234) and pagoda mirror (54–57% pixel change in two water cells, avg diff ~190/765) now verified by render-diff. Night/sunset/low-quality pond views checked (0 errors, water not pure black, sunset glow reflected), full --all clean (0 errors, fps 60.4–60.6, pond edge 24.2).

Built src/koi.js: 6 procedural koi (merged lathe bodies + tail fans, 1 atlas texture, 1 draw call, CPU wiggle, surface-grazing loop paths, water alpha 0.5 for see-through, __diag.koi=6). Fixed the lathe profile-direction bug (nose was at −z) and verified 0 errors, fps 60.3, reflections still strong. Remaining: confirm recognisability after the just-committed enlargement (unverified) + a motion check.

Made the 6 koi clearly recognisable in the pond view: their backs now break the surface (negative dMin), added a light conforming pond-liner floor to pond.js so the basin isn't black, and raised the pond camera to a steeper closer shot framing the koi cluster centre. Verified via hide/show render-diff (orange 400 / white 1584 / black 3826 px, centroid dead-centre), motion (all 6 swim 0.91u/2s), reflections (570k water px change with pagoda hidden), and shot --all (all 7 views 0 errors, fps 60.3–60.7). Committed aedccbb + e5f1a29.

T07 complete: new src/garden.js adds a taiko bridge (concave-side arched deck at x=−2.8, west of the koi), torii gate at (−22,15), 4 tōrō lanterns (2 real point lights + emissive cores, glow driven by new skySys.night), and a 34-stone stepping path torii→bridge→pagoda, all merged per material (~12 draw calls). Verified via pixel probes (torii 18.8k-px hide-diff with red body + black kasagi, bridge 71.5k red px with 0% koi overlap, night lights max Δ613/765) and shot.mjs --all: 0 errors, fps 60.3–60.5, drawCalls ≤64 in all 7 views. Stats-only review (model can't read PNGs), noted in handoff.

T08 cherry trees: added src/trees.js (7 seeded sakura — 5-level recursive branching trunks merged to 1 draw call, 490 instanced flat-shaded blossom puffs with per-tree colour bias, vertex-shader wind sway, instanced ground petals; 3 draw calls total). Verified stats-only: all 7 views 0 errors, fps 60.4–60.6, drawCalls 38–69, trees=7 in diag, pagoda view 29k pink px with 640×587px wide crown span (non-lollipop), petals visible at trunk bases, sway motion confirmed, and low-quality branch clean.

Added src/vegetation.js (7 draw calls): 13k instanced wind-swaying grass blades, 90 flowers, 8 mossy displaced boulders, 2 bamboo groves (merged stalks + instanced leaves), path shrubs and moss patches, with pond/path/torii/pagoda exclusions and a reserved zen-garden site. Fixed a high-bit loss bug in the meadow-noise hash. Verified: shot --all 0 errors, fps 60.3–60.6 in all 7 views, ground pixel probes read grass-green everywhere, sway motion and seed-7/low-quality re-scatter confirmed.

Built src/zen.js: raked gravel bed (terrain tray flatten, 1024px raked texture with parallel ridges + concentric stone circles in color/normal maps, 3 zen stones + 26-stone curb, 2 draw calls) at (20,2) — relocated from (11,3) after shadow-cone analysis showed the old site sat in the sakura shadows at all review times. Verified all 7 views 0 errors / 60.3–60.6 fps, bed bright in sun with strong rake contrast in close-up probes. Left: rake-line readability check in the overview preset itself (possible SP/contrast bump), seed=7 and quality=low checks, then tick done.

Built src/zen.js: raked gravel bed at (20,2) (terrain tray flatten, conforming gravel fan with procedural rake-line color+normal texture incl. concentric circles around 3 placed stones, 26-stone curb, 2 draw calls); site moved from the reserved (11,3) which sat in the sakura shadow all day. All 7 views: 0 errors, 60.3–60.6 fps; close-up probe shows strong rake contrast (range 48–226, edge 37.7%). Remaining: confirm rake-line readability at overview distance (possibly widen rake spacing/contrast), seed=7 + quality=low checks.

Finished the zen garden: in-page mipmap A/B proved texture rake ridges are fully minified away at overview scale, so the gravel fan now carries geometric macro ridges (1.0u, ±0.045u) aligned with 0.5u texture ridges (axis rotated to world z, gravel albedo dropped out of the ACES shoulder). Verified via pixel probes: clean-gravel row shows ±35-level ~10px periodic rake relief in the daylight overview, 0 moss/grass cells and 0 Z-fight pixels on the bed, close-up detail intact; shot --all = 0 errors, fps 60.4–60.6 on all 7 views, seed=7 and quality=low pass.

Added src/petals.js: wind-driven instanced falling petals (petals= 0–3000, settle on terrain/water, respawn) and 40 night-gated additive firefly points. Key fix: petal texture redrawn to fill the full canvas — mip-averaged alpha was below alphaTest at overview distance, silently discarding every petal (verified A/B in-page). Verified: petals visible in day views (pagoda 2097 pink px diff), fireflies in night view (444 px diff, 58 warm cores), count follows petals= (0/800/1500/3000), all 7 views 0 errors, fps 60.4–60.6, seed=7 and quality=low OK.
